title: bin/shoot takes a stub script per page, so a page that needs window.claude can be shot
why: bin/shoot cannot load the stand-in for the waiting page's data store (window.claude), and the repo has no .claude/shoot.json. So the #2034 design check used a scratch Playwright script (lane notes-fix-page (session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8), 08:23 CST Nov 8). A scratch script is a second home for the screenshot capability.
note: Extends bin/shoot (decision shoot-is-one-shared-command), one home. Done check: a red test where bin/shoot with a page's stub script shoots the waiting page with its data shown. Build lane. Filed by triage 08:25 CST Nov 8.
